verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents an official CLI, but it ships as part of the Ruby gem and the only command evidenced is `honeybadger deploy` for deployment notification. Nothing shows the CLI querying faults, managing projects, or offering output suited to agentic workflows. missing for 10: standalone language-agnostic CLI, evidence of commands beyond deploy (fault querying, project management, Insights queries), machine-readable/agent-oriented output, independent or hands-on corroboration.
